scope: HTML design prototype only; not native Rust/egui
checks: prototype is visibly distinguished from a native screenshot
empty search has a real empty state
keyboard search shortcut focuses the input
opening a detail marks it read
archive removes the selected event from inbox
pause has an explicit visible state
theme switch enables the light palette
settings expose 4 event rules plus 2 notification switches
banner preview does not reveal private metadata by default
content preview requires the explicit switch
1000px viewport has no document-level horizontal overflow
no network requests from the prototype
